reply_connected: Connected. Send a voice or text note and I will file it in the vault. 🧠
reply_transcribe_failed: Audio received but it could not be transcribed. Likely cause: the 20 MB download limit or a whisper error. The recording did not reach the vault.
reply_no_speech: Audio received but no speech was detected (silence or a whisper artefact). The recording did not reach the vault.
reply_unsupported: This message type cannot be processed ({kinds}), it did not reach the vault. You can send a voice note, an audio file, a photo or text.
